title: env-log-level
request: Add support for setting the Langfuse logger level via a LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL env var (e.g. INFO) so I can control log verbosity without using debug flag.
reference_diff:
--- a/langfuse/logger.py
+++ b/langfuse/logger.py
@@ -12,10 +12,20 @@
 """
 
 import logging
+import os
 
 # Create the main Langfuse logger
 langfuse_logger = logging.getLogger("langfuse")
-langfuse_logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)
+# Set level from environment variable LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL if provided, otherwise default to WARNING
+_log_level_str = os.getenv("LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL")
+if _log_level_str:
+    _log_level = getattr(logging, _log_level_str.upper(), None)
+    if isinstance(_log_level, int):
+        langfuse_logger.setLevel(_log_level)
+    else:
+        langfuse_logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)
+else:
+    langfuse_logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)
 
 # Configure httpx logger to reduce noise from HTTP requests
 httpx_logger = logging.getLogger("httpx")
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_logger_log_level.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import os
+import importlib
+import logging
+
+def test_log_level_via_env():
+    # Set environment variable to request INFO level
+    os.environ["LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL"] = "INFO"
+    # Reload the logger module so it reads the new env var
+    logger = importlib.import_module("langfuse.logger")
+    importlib.reload(logger)
+    try:
+        assert logger.langfuse_logger.level == logging.INFO
+    finally:
+        # Clean up: remove env var and reset logger level for other tests
+        os.environ.pop("LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL")
+        logger.langfuse_logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)
